ko.title: 다시 묶고 출발
ko.caption: 다시 묶고 출발
ko.intro: 아이보리 이너 위에 세이지 셸을 가볍게 걸치고 타이츠로 움직임을 편하게 해요. 신발끈을 정리할 때는 통행을 방해하지 않는 곳에서 멈추세요.

en.title: LACE UP AND GO
en.caption: Lace up and go
en.intro: Wear the sage shell over an ivory base with fitted tights for easy movement. Stop clear of foot traffic before adjusting your laces.

de.title: LACE UP AND GO
de.caption: Schnüren und weiterlaufen
de.intro: Kombiniere die salbeigrüne Jacke mit einem elfenbeinfarbenen Funktionslayer und eng anliegenden Tights. Halte zum Schnüren abseits des Laufwegs an.

copy.pull: ONE KNOT, THEN BACK TO IT.
copy.tipNote: The batch supplies no separate tip; the look-level howToWear (incl. its safety sentence) is the intro.

products.descriptor: muted sage olive lightweight hooded running rain jacket, full front zipper, narrow silver reflective slash on upper chest near shoulder, elastic cuffs
products.restorationNote: Front jacket, hood and shoulder reflector visible.

howToWear.ko: 지퍼는 가슴 아래까지만 올려 아이보리 이너가 보이게 하고, 비가 약해지면 후드는 등 뒤로 내려 두세요.
howToWear.en: Zip only to below the chest so the ivory base shows, and let the hood rest on your back when the rain eases.
howToWear.de: Den Reißverschluss nur bis unter die Brust schließen, damit der helle Layer sichtbar bleibt; bei nachlassendem Regen die Kapuze hinten liegen lassen.

products.descriptor: warm ivory technical crewneck long sleeve base layer, close fit, plain cuffs
products.restorationNote: Ivory neckline torso and cuffs visible, rest inferred.

howToWear.ko: 아이보리 소매 끝을 셸 소매 밖으로 조금 내어 손목을 덮고, 몸판은 타이츠 허리 위로 편하게 둬요.
howToWear.en: Let the ivory cuffs show a little past the shell sleeves to cover the wrists, and leave the body loose over the waistband.
howToWear.de: Die hellen Bündchen etwas unter den Jackenärmeln hervorschauen lassen, um die Handgelenke zu bedecken; den Saum locker über dem Bund tragen.

products.descriptor: charcoal almost-black full-length fitted running tights with curved knee panel seams, no invented large reflectors
products.restorationNote: Bent knee panel seams and fitted silhouette visible.

howToWear.ko: 무릎 절개선이 무릎 위치에 오게 당겨 입어, 다리를 올려 끈을 묶을 때도 당기지 않게 해요.
howToWear.en: Pull the tights up so the curved knee seams sit on your knees and nothing tugs when you lift a foot to tie a lace.
howToWear.de: Die Tights so hochziehen, dass die gebogenen Knienähte auf dem Knie sitzen und beim Schnüren mit angehobenem Bein nichts spannt.

howToWear.ko: 회색 양말은 접지 않고 곧게 올려 신발 칼라와 타이츠 사이를 메워요.
howToWear.en: Pull the grey socks straight up, unfolded, to close the gap between shoe collar and tights.
howToWear.de: Die grauen Socken glatt hochziehen, ohne sie umzuschlagen, damit sie die Lücke zwischen Schuhrand und Tights schließen.

howToWear.ko: 젖은 끈은 쉽게 풀리니 이중 매듭으로 묶고, 남는 끈 끝은 신발 안쪽으로 정리해요.
howToWear.en: Wet laces loosen easily, so tie a double knot and tuck the loose ends inside.
